# netactuate_sshkey (Data Source)

Reads a Sshkey.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_sshkey" "example" {
  id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `key` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `name` (String) Display name for the object.
